description: This is a Python source file for a Streamlit web application that implements a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) question-answering interface for textbook chapters. It manages UI layout, session state, and integrates with external services like OpenAI and a vector store for content retrieval.

classes.name: LocalVectorStore
classes.description: A class for managing local vector storage and search functionalities.

classes.name: EmbeddingManager
classes.description: A class responsible for generating embeddings for text queries.

methods.name: generate_rag_answer
methods.description: Asynchronous function that performs content retrieval from vector store and generates an answer using OpenAI's API based on the retrieved context.
